en: “Good morning—”
“Hey, hey—Stop sleeping, it's morning!”
“If you won't wake up... Take this!”
*THUMP*
“AH!”
Suddenly, a soft weight presses down on me. The unexpected pressure makes me shout out in surprise.
I open my eyes to see Ayano sitting on top of me.
Even though there's a blanket between us, I can distinctly feel the contour of Ayano's hips.
“Ayano... what are you doing...?”
“It's morning, get up!”
“Now... it's not even six yet...?”
“Today is Sunday, it's a waste to just sleep the day away.”
“Don't you usually sleep till almost noon...?”
“Today is different!”
“Anyway—hurry up, hurry up!”
Ayano starts to shake her body, bouncing up and down on top of me.
“Alright, alright, I'm up, I'm up!”
“That's more like it.”
“...*sigh*... You must be hungry, right? I'll make breakfast.”
“Hey—are you treating me like a pet?”
“Ayano... I can't concentrate with you staring at me like that.”
“And don't you hate cooking?”
“Watching you cook is different from doing it myself.”
“I see...”
“Is there anything I can help with?”
“Could you grab these ingredients from the fridge and wash them? I'm thinking of making a salad.”
“Alright!”
“Do you have any plans for later?”
“Going on a trip.”
“A trip?”
“Yeah, with you.”
“I see... Eh?”
“I thought I'd take you out for some fun, to relax a bit.”
“Come to think of it, you hardly ever take a break.”
“I've already talked to Kasumi and Shizuku about it.”
“So that's why we had to get up so early...?”
“Right, the buses don't come often, and it takes a while to get to the city.”
“Don't worry, I'll take good care of you! Leave it to me!”
“Hey hey, it's burning, the bacon is burning!”
“Ah!!!! Not good!”
“This is the first time I've seen you mess up like this. Put it on the plate over there.”
“Okay, okay...”
“But it seems like a waste.”
“I'll eat it—!”
“Wait, wait—!”
Half of the bacon slices are clearly burnt black.
But Ayano still gobbles them down in one bite.
“Mmm—Even the burnt part is delicious!”
“What's up?”
“Nothing... just feeling old, I guess.”
“Idiot, you're only 20.”
“Well, my mind feels a lot older...”
“Haha, let's get everything ready!”
“Today's going to be tons of fun!”
“Okay!”
And so, the two of us quickly finish breakfast, pack up Kasumi's and Shizuku's portions, and set off.
We laugh and chat the whole way there. Ayano's in a great mood and I can't wait to get there.
But things didn't go according to plan...
“I'm sorry...”
A sudden heavy rain in the city ruined Ayano's plans.
Glancing at the nearby news, it seems the rain is going to last a while and won't stop anytime soon.
“I'm really sorry... If I had checked the weather...”
Ayano, completely drenched, keeps apologizing to me, looking at the floor. She seems to think she let me down or something.
This is the first time I've seen her like this.
Tears are streaming down her cheeks,
and my heart feels like it's being tugged at.
She's crying because her plan to help me have some fun failed.
A mix of emotions swirls inside me—from amusement to sympathy, from finding her adorable to feeling sorry for her...
But I just can't take seeing her like this.
I walk over to Ayano and lift her chin with my left hand.
Gently wiping the tears from her face with my thumb, I look at her tenderly.
“It's okay, we'll have plenty of chances in the future.”
“But... you were really looking forward to it...”
“That's because I'm with you, Ayano. That's why I was excited. It wasn't because of where we were going.”
“Really...?”
“Of course. From the moment you said you'd take me out, I was looking forward to spending time with you, that's all.”
“But... but...”
“Yeah, I understand—it's disappointing when plans get ruined.”
“So, why don't we go somewhere else?”
“Like KTV! I've always wanted to try that!”
“Ah... um... in that case...”
“Right? You must have a lot of indoor backups in mind, Ayano?”
“Any of those would be a first for me, so anywhere is fine—”
“As long as I'm with you, it'll be a blast!”
“Idiot...”
“You're cuter when you smile, don't make that sad face again.”
“Okay...”
“So where were you planning to take me?”
“An amusement park...”
“I see—then we'll go to one next time!”
“Mkay! I'll definitely take you next time—!”
We end up going to a KTV.
But soon after, Ayano starts acting weird...
As I wonder why, she records my singing voice and plays it back to me...
Oh my god... what a nightmare.
